# Namepass developer documentation

> Integrate USDC funding for ENS renewals with get-address, send-USDC and transaction polling. No API keys. API version 2026-09-30. Testnet availability is controlled by the operator; docs availability is not a mainnet launch.

## Guides and API operations

- [Introduction](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/introduction.md): Get an address. Send USDC. Poll until renewed.
- [Quickstart](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/quickstart.md): Integrate Namepass with two HTTP calls and your existing wallet.
- [Get an address](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/addresses.md): Activate an ENS name and retrieve its deposit address.
- [Estimate renewal time](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/quotes.md): See what an amount of USDC buys using the active on-chain price.
- [Poll status](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/status.md): Track a deposit through to renewal using its transaction hash and chain ID.
- [Name history](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/history.md): Read past renewal flows and recorded expiry for a specific ENS name.
- [Use an agent](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/agents.md): Let your existing wallet or coding agent use the same simple HTTP flow.
- [Integration skill](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/skills.md): A short get-address, send, poll workflow for agents.
- [API reference](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference.md): Four public endpoints. No Namepass API keys.
- [Get a deposit address](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_address.md): POST /api/v1/address
- [Poll a transaction](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_status.md): GET /api/v1/status/{chainId}
- [Estimate a renewal](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/post_quote.md): POST /api/v1/quote
- [List a name's renewals](https://beta.namepass.com/docs/reference/get_name_renewals.md): GET /api/v1/names/{name}/renewals
